### Load packages

```{r load-packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(GenomicFeatures)
  library(Biostrings)
  library(rtracklayer)
  library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39)
  library(dplyr)
  library(rprojroot)
  library(GenomeInfoDb)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(rtracklayer)
})
```

### Set directory paths

```{r dir-paths}
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-novel-mirna-target-prediction")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "input")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
```

### Set GTF file path 

```{r file-paths}
gtf_file <- file.path(data_dir, "Mus_musculus.GRCm39.115.gtf.gz") # add data download script
```

### Create TxDb and extract 3′ UTRs

```{r create-txdb}
txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF(gtf_file, format = "gtf")
three_utrs <- threeUTRsByTranscript(txdb, use.names = TRUE)
```

### Load mouse genome and extract sequences

```{r extract-sequences}
genome <- BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39

seqlevelsStyle(txdb) <- seqlevelsStyle(genome)
seqlevelsStyle(three_utrs) <- seqlevelsStyle(genome)

valid_chroms <- intersect(seqlevels(three_utrs), seqnames(genome))
three_utrs_filtered <- keepSeqlevels(three_utrs, valid_chroms, pruning.mode = "coarse")
utr_seqs <- extractTranscriptSeqs(genome, three_utrs_filtered)
```

### Save 3′ UTR sequences to FASTA

```{r save-fasta, message=TRUE}
utr_fasta_path <- file.path(results_dir, "Mus_musculus.GRCm39.3utr.fa")
writeXStringSet(utr_seqs, filepath = utr_fasta_path)
message("✅ Saved 3′ UTR FASTA: ", utr_fasta_path)
```

### Prepare DE miRNAs and run miRanda

```{r run-miranda}
# Input files
de_mirna_csv <- file.path(input_dir, "mouse_sig_DE_miRNA_list.csv") # update after PR #129 is merged
all_mirna_fa <- file.path(input_dir, "30-963755216-all_miRNA.fa") # need new data release
de_mirna_fa  <- file.path(results_dir, "mouse_DE_miRNA.fa")

# Extract DE miRNA IDs
de_ids <- read.csv(de_mirna_csv, header = TRUE)[,1] |> unique()
all_fa <- readRNAStringSet(all_mirna_fa)
de_fa <- all_fa[names(all_fa) %in% de_ids]
writeXStringSet(de_fa, de_mirna_fa)

# Run miRanda
miranda_out <- file.path(results_dir, "mouse_miranda_output.txt")
cmd <- sprintf("miranda %s %s -sc 140 -en -20 -out %s",
               de_mirna_fa, utr_fasta_path, miranda_out) # check runtime in EC2
message("🚀 Running miRanda...")
system(cmd)
message("✅ miRanda completed. Results: ", miranda_out)
```

### Parse and Annotate miRanda Results

```{r parse-annotate-miranda-results}
annotated_csv <- file.path(results_dir, "mouse_miranda_output_parsed_anno.csv")

# Parse miRanda raw output
lines <- readLines(miranda_out)
pred_lines <- lines[str_detect(lines, "^>>")]
fields <- str_split_fixed(str_sub(pred_lines, 3), "\t", n = 10)

parsed_df <- tibble(
  Seq1        = fields[,1],  # miRNA
  Seq2    = fields[,2],  # target
  Max_Score   = as.numeric(fields[,5]),
  Max_Energy  = as.numeric(fields[,6]),
  Len1        = as.integer(fields[,8]),
  Len2        = as.integer(fields[,9]),
  Positions   = str_trim(fields[,10])
)

# Read GTF and build transcript–gene mapping
gtf <- import(gtf_file)
transcript_anno <- gtf[gtf$type == "transcript"]

transcript_df <- as.data.frame(mcols(transcript_anno)) %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id, gene_id, gene_name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    transcript_id_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", transcript_id),
    gene_id_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", gene_id)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, gene_name)

# Join annotations and export
miranda_annotated <- parsed_df %>%
  left_join(transcript_df, by = c("Seq2" = "transcript_id_clean")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(GeneID = gene_id_clean, GeneSymbol = gene_name)

write_csv(miranda_annotated, annotated_csv)

message("✅ miRanda results parsed and annotated: ", annotated_csv)
```
